records.text: Nicepool, and it is just supposed to be about, of course, Justin Baldoni. Let us not forget that Ryan Reynolds then jumped into Blake Lively and Justin Baldoni’s movie, appearing to do a movie promo of It Ends with Us. But it was not actually a movie promo; it was more of an opportunity for him and his buddy Hugh Jackman—two A-listers—to make fun of Justin Baldoni even throughout his own movie promotion. It was totally and utterly sadistic. It makes me not like Hugh Jackman anymore.
